title: Yellow Graffiti Girl Poses
description: Four distinct poses of the same cartoon girl with voluminous bright yellow hair, wearing a black and yellow tracksuit with 'WTF' on the chest. She holds a spray paint can in multiple views, creating yellow starburst spray effects and a floating black hammer in one pose. All figures stand against a solid dark gray background.
prompt: A cartoon character sheet showing four different dynamic poses of a cool graffiti girl with huge voluminous bright yellow hair, wearing a black and yellow tracksuit with 'WTF' logo, black boots, and headband. She holds a spray can emitting yellow starburst paint effects in multiple views, one pose includes a floating black hammer. Bold outlines, vibrant colors, clean vector style on dark gray background.
